shared_elements: low-relief incised symbols on a flat panel
roughly symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief symbols including a prominent circular disc and humanoid figures organised symmetrically about a vertical axis, but these are generic correspondences any tradition could reach independently. A is a single frontal, three-dimensional body-shaped figure with emblems distributed over head, chest and torso, whereas B is a flat framed panel with two profile figures (one animal-headed) flanking a central offering stand under an arched canopy, accompanied by rows of small script-like signs — a scene type entirely absent from A.
